title.en: amsterdam light festival opens on the canals.
title.de: amsterdam light festival öffnet auf den grachten.

line.en: fifty-three days of light art on the canals, opening 26 nov, 16:30 to 23:00. walk the amstel or take a boat.
line.de: dreiundfünfzig tage lichtkunst auf den grachten, eröffnung am 26. november, 16:30 bis 23:00. spazieren am amstel oder mit dem boot.
line.tr: kanallarda elli üç gün ışık sanatı, 26 kasım'da açılış, 16:30 - 23:00. amstel boyunca yürü ya da bir tekneye bin.

sparks.why: Amsterdam Light Festival 2026-27, opens Thu 26 nov, 16:30 to 23:00, per iamsterdam.com. The festtr.com date was discarded as conflicting with the rest.
